audit_items.proof_trace: The function literally implements the formula: numerator = debt.add_u64(cash).sub(cash_reserve) and denominator = total_supply (L74-76, L92-101), so the property holds by construction. All mutating operations (mint, burn, borrow, repay, accrue_interest, liquidate, flash loan) atomically maintain the constituent fields: withdraw_underlying enforces cash >= cash_reserve.ceil() after every cash reduction (preventing numerator underflow), total_supply == 0 is guarded, and flash loans intentionally leave self.cash unchanged (neutral to accounting) with underlying_balance restored on repayment via increase_reserve_only.
